notes.title: New Playtest Now Live! Plus: New Publisher and Convergence Reveal
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]A lot has swiftly evolved today in the world of Everything is Crab, and we’re here to cover it all in a handy dandy blog!   We’re excited to announce that a brand new playtest is live now! Starting today, you can join in on the ever-mutating fun by heading to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3526710/Everything_is_Crab_The_Animal_Evolution_Roguelite/"]Steam store page [/url]to hunt, flee, scavenge, and chomp your way through enemies and bosses![/p][p][/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback, suggestions, and reports of pesky bugs that you may have come across during your time in the playtest. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/MRvkGBAWQh"]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts and keep up to date on the latest Everything is Crab news! [/p][p][/p][p]What else is there to share? Well, we announced a partnership with Secret Mode during the Convergence showcase! Alongside this, we shared a new trailer, and confirmed our plans to launch Everything is Crab in 2026. Check out the fancy trailer here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6hvs0vpCsJ8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]What does Secret Mode joining the Crab crew mean? It’ll mean that lots more folks will have a chance to discover the game, and that our lovely ever-evolving community will have even more ways to chat with the team and get more insight, as we slide our way towards that 2026 launch.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505855/b5fd7d89d1f35cbd2dda835401971b049b2eb707.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Check out [u][url="http://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode"]Secret Mode channels[/url][/u] for all the big news for Everything is Crab, and for extra insight from the devs, follow Odd Dreams Digital [u][url="https://x.com/OddDreams_D"]on X[/url][/u], [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/odddreamsdigital.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [/u]and join the [url="https://discord.gg/MRvkGBAWQh"]Discord![/url][/p][p]
[i]Carcinisation - a form of convergent evolution where non-crab crustaceans independently evolve into a crab-like body. [/i]🦀[/p]
